reasons: The cited § 2.1 is a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay obligation on Customer with no reduction or termination right, which is squarely the MINCOMMIT walk-away position, so the deviation classification is correct.

Full deletion is the minimal effective edit here because the entire paragraph is the offending commitment and no residual operative language needs preserving; § 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment) and § 7.1 (Fees limited to Order Form amounts, no minimum-use charges) already carry the preferred no-commitment position, so no substitute wording is required and internal consistency improves.

Directionally correct for the customer: it removes a customer-side obligation without disturbing any Vendor-side commitment, consistent with the detection guidance that Vendor commitments to us are acceptable.

Comment complies with tone and format requirements — prefixed, concise, first-person plural, explains what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and offers the sanctioned fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up instead of penalty) without lecturing.
Deterministic check confirms the deletion operation applies cleanly to p0012, and the rendered redline matches the stated intent.
